reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience with Rene and the team at ElDorado pools. WE absolutely love our new pool and spa. Rene was attentive, friendly and knowledgeable from the design, through construction and startup. We could not be more thrilled and highly recommend El Dorado Pools.
reviews.author: hilary satz

reviews.text: We are very happy with the hot tub that El Dorado added to our pool. It looks like it was there all along! They worked quickly and professionally all while communicating the entire process with us. We look forward to relaxing in the hot tub for years to come thanks to El Dorado!
reviews.author: Jeff McVaney

reviews.text:
Phenomenal Backyard Transformation!
We recently had a comprehensive outdoor project completed by El Dorado and we are thrilled with the results. Our transformation included a new pool, a custom-built cabana, outdoor kitchen, and artificial turf.
From the very beginning, what truly set this company apart was the hands-on involvement of the owner, Rene. This personal dedication ensured that every aspect of the project, no matter how small, received meticulous attention and oversight. It's rare to find such a direct and engaged approach.
The entire project was completed with impressive speed, without ever compromising on quality. We were amazed at how efficiently the team worked. The cabana, in particular, showcases their incredible craftsmanship and attention to detail.
We are beyond pleased with our new backyard oasis and would enthusiastically recommend El Dorado to anyone looking for a company that delivers on its promises with efficiency, expertise, and a truly hands-on commitment to excellence.
reviews.author: Laura Berry

reviews.text: We could not be more satisfied with the entire process of building our pool with Rene and his team. We finished ahead of schedule and on budget. The results are simply beyond our wildest expectations.
reviews.author: Nathan Goldstein

reviews.text: El Dorado pools designed us our dream pool without a hitch! They were very easy to work with and we now have a gorgeous pool to dip into in the Summer!
reviews.author: Hillary Grassano

reviews.text: A top-tier pool designer and builder.  Rene Castro and El Dorado Pools brings an eye to design and commitment to excellence and quality that is unsurpassed.  We are so happy with our new pool!
reviews.author: Bud Dunn

reviews.text: We built our pool three years ago and waited to write a review once we had experience dealing with warranties.  If this review were strictly based on the looks and enjoyment of our pool, it would be 4, maybe 5 stars.  But this review is about the total experience.  The pool build, mostly pre-pandemic, went smoothly and was completed on time.  The office manager, Kelli, who no longer works there, was a nightmare to deal with.  She forgot to collect payments, rarely answered our requests in a timely fashion and was generally argumentative any time we had concerns.  We have had exactly ZERO interaction with Rene since our build was completed.  He's not interested in long-term customer satisfaction.  While we were in the first year, we discovered a leak from the spa, into the pool.  They sent their team out and "repaired" the leak, but it has since began leaking again.  We reported this challenge, along with leaks around the pool equipment, and we were simply told the warranty does not cover any of what we reported.  When we asked if they would send someone out to make sure none of it was covered, they stopped responding.  Not only did they decide we were not covered through email, they also will not stand by their original warranty repair work.  Rene is a smooth talker, and he has plenty of subcontractors who know how to build a solid pool but there's very little substance beyond that. Further, we have referred clients to him and learned he either didn't respond at all or no-showed appointments he had scheduled.  I'm sure there will be an apology response to this review, but apologies don't correct an easily avoidable, poor customer experience.
reviews.author: Dominic Pelletrino

reviews.text: Exceptional experience from beginning to the end.  Kelli, the office manager, was professionally responsive from our initial inquiry, proactive throughout all stages, patient in the materials selection and all questions/concerns including multiple vendor coordination.  Rene, as the owner, personally navigated us through the entire process from the initial design to completion reality.  Rene came by and ensured critical build stages and milestones were met.  His leadership with the various construction teams was superb in staying focused on the design, the equipment functionality and the aesthetics.  For the pool fine tuning, final touches and minor issue resolutions, Rockey’s competent problem solving skills and customer centric interactions were outstanding. Highly recommend El Dorado Pools because of Rene, Kelli and Rockey.  What a trustworthy and amazing team.
reviews.author: Henry Shim

data.summary: The reviews present a mixed but authentic picture. Positive reviews praise the owner's involvement and the final product. However, a highly detailed negative review reveals significant issues with post-construction warranty service and office management, which aligns with the modest overall ratings. The lack of middle-ground reviews in the sample is a minor red flag, but the content of the existing reviews feels genuine.
fake_signals: Strategic sample shows only 5-star and 1-2 star reviews, lacking middle-ground 3-4 star reviews in the provided data, which is unusual for a natural distribution.
Some 5-star reviews are generic and lack specific project details (e.g., 'wonderful experience', 'thrilled').

negative_evidence: The critical 1-star review is explicitly about poor warranty and post-sale experience, stating the review would have been positive based on the build alone.

authentic_signals: Specific details in positive reviews (owner Rene, office manager Kelli, project types like pools, spas, cabanas).
The 1-star review is highly detailed, names specific individuals, and provides a timeline, lending it strong credibility.
Varied writing styles and perspectives among reviewers.
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistent across Google and Yelp, both in the low-to-mid 3-star range, indicating a coherent story of mixed customer satisfaction.
